headline: Committee passes 5-4 residential-use criterion that excludes flood hazard area properties

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Motions to leave out properties mauka of South Kīhei Road and to leave off eight properties with over 25% residential use each failed 4-5. The discussed conditions will go to the Maui Planning Commission as ideas in the committee report.
meeting.recap: Staff handed out a list showing which properties are in the sea level rise exposure area, flood zones, or shoreline setback area.[[0:48:09]] Staff said a property met a criterion if more than half of its building footprint was in that area.[[0:59:50]] Member Paltin moved to leave out properties mauka (toward the mountain) of South Kīhei Road.[[1:00:37]] That motion failed, with four ayes and five noes.[[1:36:51]] A council member proposed leaving off the list eight properties with more than 25% residential use by owners or long-term renters.[[1:41:16]] The member said the goal is to reclaim housing from the tourism industry.[[1:42:09]] That motion failed, with four ayes and five noes.[[2:05:57]] That motion passed, with five ayes and four noes.[[2:07:55]] The chair said the discussed conditions will be sent to the Maui Planning Commission as ideas in the committee report.[[2:08:36]] Member Cook moved to recommend adoption of resolution 26-129.[[2:18:09]] The chair said the passed flood-zone criterion affects three properties.[[2:19:53]] The committee took a two-minute recess before any vote on the resolution.[[2:22:48]]
decided: A motion to recommend adoption of resolution 26-129 was made and seconded, but no vote was taken in this recording.
meeting.next: The chair said the committee will take a one-month break from committee meetings. The chair said the discussed conditions will be sent to the Maui Planning Commission in the committee report.

moments.q: Motion to leave out properties mauka of South Kīhei Road
"Families in my community were pushed out because more money could be made renting it out nightly than monthly."

issues.brief: The committee passed, 5 to 4, a residential-use criterion that does not apply to properties in the flood hazard area.[[#1]]
